query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS terpene_synergies (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  terpene1_id INT NOT NULL,
  terpene2_id INT NOT NULL,
  compatibility_score INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 50 COMMENT '0-100: 0-30=rouge, 31-70=jaune, 71-100=vert',
  synergy_notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE KEY unique_pair (terpene1_id, terpene2_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (terpene1_id) REFERENCES molecules(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (terpene2_id) REFERENCES molecules(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
